items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Interviewer mentions Sawadick as part of a group ('Black Benny and, and Aaron Harris and Sawadick and all those guys') and Interviewee responds generally about the group ('I know they had some bad women too...'), indicating awareness but no personal interaction described.

ctx.x: He was, he was pretty bad. I think he played drums too. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Black Benny was, he was quite though, bad though. He was in a bad gang.

Mm-hmm. Yeah. And, uh, did I ask you about Aaron Harris? Aaron. Aaron Harris. He was a bad, bad man. No, I just can't praise him, huh? Sawadick? Who? Sawadick was one of them. That's what his nickname was. That I heard about him. Well, you know, they were all in a bunch, Black Benny and, and Aaron Harris and Sawadick and all those guys. Mm-hmm. That's a big point. Yeah.
I know they had some bad women too back, I think too, you know. Mary Jack the Bear.
